method: One EM prior-shift candidate; source-calibrated scores for both systems
sampling: Without replacement inside held-out fold; deterministic seed=base+100*fold+scenario_index; same members for both systems
source_calibration: Same unregularized Platt fit as R2, trained on other-fold OOF scores; not a new calibrator selection
source_prior: Mean source-calibrated probabilities on source fitting records; not target truth
gate: Each system: equal-weight mean delta ACC>0, log_loss<0, MCC>=0, Brier<=0 across 15 conditions; BOTH pass to enter challenge adaptation. Any boundary estimate fails gate. No significance claim.
original_baselines: Frozen R3 outputs remain authoritative; DSP source-calibrated baseline uses existing R2 Platt
failure: Explicit stop on hash/schema/fit/convergence/ranking error; no fallback
limitations: Prior results already seen; exploratory, not preregistered before challenge disclosure.
Simulated pure prior shifts do not establish real target conditional-distribution stability.
Source OOF single-member to deployed ensemble distribution mismatch remains.
Batch-dependent predictions, not unchanged single-record deployment.
